verdict.rationale: TeamViewer's own pricing page lists 'Enhanced mass deployment (MSI)', which is a product-level bulk action that rolls the client out across many endpoints at once. 'Remote script execution' and 'automating recurring fixes' hint at fleet-wide actions, but nothing shows selecting many devices or items and acting on them together. The Web API is only a developer building block, so it earns no credit here. Missing for 10: documented bulk or multi-select actions across devices or items in the console, bulk endpoints in the API, AI-driven batch operations, and any hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
